nodes.label: App Icon (Two Lights)
nodes.description: 512x512 rounded-square (rx=112) app/PWA icon on dark #17121C background with two overlapping circles: a pink/coral #FF7C8F circle (left, 'you') and a semi-transparent amber #FFBE5C circle (right, 'partner'), overlapping in the center.

nodes.label: Two Lights Motif (You and Partner)
nodes.rationale: Icon represents the couple as two overlapping lights — one for the user, one for the partner — expressing closeness/connection; colors map to design tokens (dark bg, you, partner).
